study type: Secondary analysis of a registry database
exposure: Predicted probability of VBAC from the MFMU VBAC prediction model without race and ethnicity
cohort: 353 individuals with two prior cesarean deliveries attempting a trial of labor.
finding: The MFMU VBAC prediction model without race and ethnicity demonstrated reasonable accuracy (AUC 0.74) for predicting vaginal birth after cesarean in individuals with two prior cesarean deliveries.
mod_finding: The MFMU VBAC prediction model showed moderate accuracy (AUC 0.74) in predicting vaginal birth after two prior cesarean deliveries.
